searchText: Is there a youtube recording for that meeting anywhere? Can't find it on the `@ethereumprotocol` youtube 🙏 Hello guys, could you remind me please, do we have an agreement what to do with 0-blob txs (reject/let them in)? Seems to me we postponed discussion about banning 0-blobs till SSZfication times, but I'm not sure I have the same question, we have a test case for this in the execution spec reference tests (coming soon) but it's currently disabled: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests/blob/caa614f1d41f4ef07b6433b3f0d4c7a4b150de1b/fillers/eips/eip4844/excess_data_gas.py#L530-L534 <@159152274659082240> <@898563924440543283> quick question, does the geth coinbase branch support `eth_getBlockByHash` request post deneb? asking beccause currnetly prysm stores blind block to DB as default. cc <@833706406699073536> Scrolling through the code it looks like eth_getBlockByHash should work yeah that method should work post deneb.
